title: Multi-lingual and Multi-cultural Figurative Language Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the 'concept shift gap' by comparing model performance on translated non-English figurative language test sets against English datasets to measure the impact of culturally-specific concepts (e.g., local foods, myths, and weather).

Measuring the 'cross-lingual transfer gap' by comparing the zero-shot and few-shot inference performance of multilingual language models (like XLM-R and mBERT) on English versus seven lower-resource languages.
